# Navigation

## Breadcrumb

`import { Breadcrumb, BreadcrumbEllipsis, BreadcrumbItem, BreadcrumbLink, BreadcrumbList, BreadcrumbPage, BreadcrumbSeparator } from '@jovertical/mise-design-system'`

Written against shadcn/ui's `breadcrumb` API, not ported from it: the names match so a reader arriving from shadcn finds what they expect. The separator is `/` and the leaf is not a disabled link.

Also takes: every HTML attribute.

### `BreadcrumbEllipsis`

Stands in for crumbs dropped from the middle of a long trail.

Also takes: every `<span>` attribute.

### `BreadcrumbItem`

`min-w-0` so a long crumb can truncate rather than push the trail past the edge. Crumbs that must never shrink (the root, the leaf) say so with `shrink-0`.

Also takes: every `<li>` attribute.

### `BreadcrumbLink`

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `child` | `Snippet<[{ props: Record<string, unknown> }]>` |  | Renders your own link with these props instead of an anchor. |

Also takes: every `<a>` attribute.

### `BreadcrumbList`

Also takes: every `<ol>` attribute.

### `BreadcrumbPage`

The leaf. Not a link, because it points at where you already are: `aria-current="page"` on plain text, not a link that refuses to be followed.

Also takes: every `<span>` attribute.

### `BreadcrumbSeparator`

`/` rather than a chevron; pass children for a different mark.

Also takes: every `<li>` attribute.

### `SidebarNav`

The app's menu drawn from data, inside `Sidebar`: sections of rows and groups, with the row that owns `current` lit and the group holding it open. Built on the sidebar's own parts, so it follows the `sidetheme`.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sections` (required) | `SidebarNavSection[]` |  |  |
| `current` (required) | `string` |  | The path to match the rows' `href`s against, e.g. the page's pathname. |
| `persistKey` | `string` |  | Remembers which groups are open in `localStorage` under this key. |
| `link` | `Snippet<[SidebarNavLinkSnippetProps]>` |  | Renders a row's link, for a router with its own (Inertia's `Link`). Without it a row is an `<a href>`, which SvelteKit routes. |

Also takes: every `<div>` attribute.

### `SidebarProvider`

Owns the open and collapsed state and the CSS variables the whole family reads. It always wraps `Sidebar` and its page, never `Sidebar` alone.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | `boolean` | `true` |  |
| `onOpenChange` | `(open: boolean) => void` |  |  |
| `mobileBreakpoint` | `number` |  | Viewport width, in pixels, below which the sidebar becomes a sheet. Raise it when the persistent rail costs the content more room than it is worth. |

Also takes: every `<div>` attribute.

## Stepper

`import { Stepper, StepperNavigation } from '@jovertical/mise-design-system'`

Where a reader is in a multi-step flow, and what is behind them.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `steps` (required) | `StepDefinition[]` |  | Each step's `id` and `name`, a `description` (required; `''` for none), and optionally `optional`, an `icon` component and a `badge` snippet. |
| `currentStepId` (required) | `string` |  |  |
| `completedSteps` | `readonly string[]` |  | Explicit completion. Any step id here is complete regardless of its position; when omitted, every step before `currentStepId` is. |
| `variant` | `'vertical' \| 'horizontal' \| 'condensed' \| 'compact'` | `'vertical'` |  |
| `showProgress` | `boolean` | `true` | Drops the "Step 3 of 9" readout and the bar from `compact`, for a flow that no longer holds anyone to an order. A bar that never moves is a worse answer than none. |
| `showCurrentStep` | `boolean` | `true` | Drops the current step's name and description from `condensed`, for a page that heads its own step body and says it better. |
| `onStepSelect` | `(stepId: string) => void` |  | Makes steps selectable. A stepper that reports progress and one that navigates look the same and are not; passing this turns the steps into buttons. |
| `selectableSteps` | `readonly string[]` |  | Which step ids accept a click; omitted means all of them. A wizard can hold you to an order going forward while letting you back to anything already visited. |
| `class` | `string` |  |  |

### `StepperNavigation`

A flow's controls, at the page's own level rather than inside its card.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `onBack` | `() => void` |  | Omit for the first step. The next action stays right regardless. |
| `backLabel` | `string` | `'Back'` |  |
| `backDisabled` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `onNext` | `() => void` |  |  |
| `nextLabel` | `string` | `'Next'` |  |
| `nextDisabled` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `nextLoading` | `boolean` | `false` | Draws a spinner in the next action. Pair it with `nextDisabled`. |
| `leading` | `Snippet` |  | At the left end, beside the back action if there is one: anything that leaves the flow rather than moving through it (Cancel, "finish later"). Leaving and advancing are opposite intentions and belong at opposite ends. |
| `trailing` | `Snippet` |  | Immediately left of the next action: a skip, which does advance. |

Also takes: every `<div>` attribute except `children`.

Types: `StepDefinition`, `StepperVariant` (`'vertical' | 'horizontal' | 'condensed' | 'compact'`).
